label: Recovery funding envelope available over the horizon
evidence_basis: No ICB-level elective recovery budget is published at any level. Set as a deliberately binding illustrative envelope, never as a sourced figure.

label: Diagnostic tests required to unlock one completed pathway
evidence_basis: No NHS dataset publishes this ratio. It is an analyst estimate.

label: Backlog to be cleared, relative to central forecast
evidence_basis: Taken from the warehouse forecast's own p5 and p95 at horizon end, relative to the central case. Measured, not assumed.

label: Achievable uplift in in-house completions
evidence_basis: Anchored on the Elective Recovery Fund's national 10% activity increase target, plus a buffer.

label: Independent-sector headroom above current commissioned activity
evidence_basis: Analyst assumption. No published measure of independent-sector spare elective capacity exists for this ICB.

label: Unit cost of activity relative to the sourced cost baseline
evidence_basis: NHS England National Cost Collection 2024/25, National Schedule of NHS costs, Summary HRG tab, England-wide, 206 providers
